description.EN: Less strain on the car; a useful approach to tight bends.
description.CN: 减少车辆负担，适合谨慎通过急弯。

description.EN: Build speed where there is room, at the cost of more fuel and wear.
description.CN: 趁路面宽敞提速，会消耗更多燃油和车况。

description.EN: A chance to gain places, with a greater risk of losing control.
description.CN: 有机会抢回名次，也更容易失控。

description.EN: The town lights fall behind. Brake lights ahead pick out the rise in the road.
description.CN: 小镇的灯光落在身后。前车的尾灯勾出了公路的坡度。

description.EN: Trees crowd the road. A pair of headlights appears beyond the next bend.
description.CN: 树木挤在公路两侧。一对车灯从前方弯道后亮起。

description.EN: The verge drops away beyond the crest. The racing line tightens sharply to the right.
description.CN: 越过坡顶，路旁的地面向下倾斜。前方的路线突然向右收紧。

description.EN: The road opens out. There is room to build speed, if your car has anything left to give.
description.CN: 公路豁然开阔。只要车子还有余力，这里正适合提速。

description.EN: Fields replace the hills. The car ahead drifts towards the centre line, guarding the easiest way past.
description.CN: 丘陵渐渐让位于田野。前车朝道路中线靠去，挡住了最容易超车的位置。

description.EN: A torch flashes beside the field entrance. Beyond it, someone waves the drivers towards a lay-by.
description.CN: 田地入口旁闪起一道手电光。越过那里，路边有人挥手，示意车手们驶向停车处。

before.EN: Kit checks the tyres on an old saloon. "Don't laugh. It still corners."
before.CN: 基特检查着一辆旧轿车的轮胎。“别笑，它过弯还灵着呢。”

win.EN: Kit gives the steering wheel a satisfied pat. "Told you."
win.CN: 基特满意地拍拍方向盘。“说过了吧。”

lose.EN: Kit studies your tyres. "Same road next time?"
lose.CN: 基特打量着你的轮胎。“下次还跑这条路？”

before.EN: Nell folds a road map and puts it away. "You can make up time without running wide."
before.CN: 内尔折好地图收了起来。“想追上去，也不必冲出路面。”

win.EN: Nell checks the time before looking up. "That'll do."
win.CN: 内尔先看了眼时间，才抬起头来。“还行。”

lose.EN: Nell nods towards the hill. "You took that bend well."
lose.CN: 内尔朝山坡点点头。“那个弯过得不错。”

before.EN: Ash blips the throttle. "Try to keep the headlights in sight."
before.CN: 阿什踩了两下油门。“尽量别连我的车灯都看不见了。”

win.EN: Ash climbs out with a grin. "Had a bit left at the end."
win.CN: 阿什笑着下了车。“到最后还留了点余力。”

lose.EN: Ash glances back down the road. "Again, when the engine cools."
lose.CN: 阿什回头看了眼公路。“等引擎凉了，再来。”
